text:
For this activity you will need 30 small cubes of the same size. You might use some building blocks, sugar cubes if you have them or cut some cheese into cubes!

Using all 30 cubes, can you make a square? Can you make a cube?

Explore which numbers below 30 make cubes or squares with none left over. How many different numbers of cubes can you use?
